title: Avoid animating layout properties
why: Animating dimensions, positions, flex bases, or grid tracks can trigger layout work on every frame and degrade responsiveness.
suggestion: Prefer transform or opacity when the same visual effect is possible, and measure before retaining a layout animation.
limitations: The rule reports explicit hard layout properties in transition declarations and keyframes in plain CSS and CSS in Svelte style blocks; custom properties and runtime-generated CSS are not resolved.
Intentional measured layout animations remain advisory because transform-based replacements are not always equivalent.
